notes:
• Live Cameras now remembers your cameras between runs — open the window and your camera list is already there, no need to scan every time. Scan Network refreshes their addresses and adds any new ones.
• The list is one clean line per camera, in camera-number order (52, 100, 161...), like the MOBOTIX software.
• Click a camera and its name, address and serial number show along the bottom.
